hypothesis: Two fictional communities. This panel is a teaching device, not a map of recovered settlements or measured journeys. Neighbors are represented here by supplies and officeholders; their villages are not explorable yet.
locked: Reach the town milestone, then commission the meeting and exchange place in Work. Your original village tutorial continues unchanged until you choose to begin this chapter.
guide: Exchange with both communities, deliver aid when requested, and keep two seasons of food at home. Maintain trust of at least 40 with each partner.
complete: Contact chapter complete. Continue balancing seasonal supply, trust, leadership changes and protection. This is a relationship milestone, not another urban stage.
start_success: Neighbor chapter begun. Their finite stores now advance with your seasons.
sent: Mission dispatched; cargo is reserved now. Workers remain committed until it returns.
cancelled: Unstarted mission cancelled; reserved goods returned within storage limits.
escort_set: Escort standing order updated. An existing mission keeps its committed escort.
escort_note: Each escort is taken from watch duty at home. Two food workers carry each mission. The steward commissions exchange and aid; the watch leader sets protection. God coordinates both. Workers rotate in seasonal relays; walking figures show preparation, not a measured journey.
no_mission: No mission in progress. Compare the offer, reserves and forecast before dispatching.
mission: Mission {id} → {neighbor}: {remaining} season(s) remaining; {escorts} escort(s); {loss}% cargo allowance. {status}
moving: Crew assigned; progresses when you resolve the season.
waiting: Waiting for enough food workers and watch staff. No progress this season.
leader: Speaker {name} · {manner} · current term has {remaining} season(s) left
risk: Forecast with current escort: {carriers} carriers + {escorts} watch staff away; {loss}% handling/weather allowance; deliver {delivered} {receive}.
risk_factors: Route pressure {pressure} − escort protection {escort_power} − leader experience {leader_power}. No random battle is rolled.
aid_line: Requested aid: {amount} {resource}, while their stock is below {below}. No goods are promised in return.
neighbor_report: Last season: food gathered {gathered}, eaten {eaten}, unmet {unfed}, spoiled {spoil}, overflow {overflow}; timber gathered {wood_gain}.
trust_report: Trust change: absence {drift}, exchange {trade}, aid {aid}; total {total}.
home_labor: Away on missions: {carriers} food workers, {escorts} watch staff. Returning this season: {food} provisions, {wood} timber.
contact_locked: Finish the town foundation and meeting place first.
contact_busy: One mission is already committed. Resolve its journey before sending another.
contact_crew: Keep two food workers and enough watch workers available for the mission.
contact_stock: You do not have enough cargo, or the food payment would breach one season of provisions at home.
contact_reserve: Their speaker will not exchange below the community’s reserve.
contact_trust: Trust is too low for exchange; aid can rebuild it when needed.
contact_aid: That community does not currently request this aid.
contact_transit: A party already on its journey cannot be recalled instantly.
contact_none: There is no mission to cancel.

events.contact_started: Neighbor contact began; two hypothetical community ledgers are now active.
events.contact_return: {mission} returned from {neighbor}: received {food} provisions and {wood} timber; cargo allowance {loss}%.
events.contact_cancelled: Cancelled {mission}; unstarted cargo reservations returned. Overflow: {food} provisions, {wood} timber.
events.contact_complete: Neighbor chapter complete: exchange, aid, trust and home reserves sustained.

cargo_report: Incoming cargo {delivered}; cargo discarded beyond their capacity {cargo_overflow}.
